spark_open.description: A single quadrupedal creature is shown in right-facing profile against a plain off-white background, standing on a faintly shaded ground. It has a stout, strongly arched body with a blunt, pale pink snout and large dark eyes, a long tapering tail extending to the left and partially cropped by the image edge, and four short, thick limbs ending in clawed feet. The dorsal surfaces of the body, back, sides, top of the head, tail, and upper legs are densely covered in overlapping rounded brown scales with darker margins, while the ventral belly, lower legs, feet, throat and face are pale pink, wrinkled skin. Prominent pink, feathery external gills with fine filaments project outward from the neck region immediately behind the head on both sides.

meta_spark.description: A stout quadrupedal creature shown in right-facing side view with an arched back. The back, top of the head, outer upper legs and long tapering tail are covered in large overlapping brown rounded scales, while the face, underside, and lower legs and feet are pale pinkish-white smooth wrinkled skin. The broad flat head has large round dark eyes on the sides, a small nostril near the tip, and a wide closed mouth. Behind the head are six pink stalked feathery external gills, three visible on each side. It stands on four short sturdy legs ending in broad five-toed feet with small dark claws, and a long scaly tail extends to the left out of frame.
